name: Starry
tagline: One prompt to editable UI, export React/HTML code
description: Starry is an AI-native design tool that turns natural language prompts into fully editable UI designs and exports production-ready React (JSX) and HTML code. Local-first, imports native Figma files, and includes an MCP server for Cursor and Claude Code. Free to use, built for product managers, designers, and developers.
